changelog: Update Recommended Version
The issue of other players seeing previews of ped's has been fixed.
The problem of stillbirth during ped change has been resolved.
The entire ped list has been updated. All known peds have been added to peds.lua.
You will now be able to see how many peds are in the category on the main menu.
The Weebhook system has been moved to config_server.lua to prevent dumps. Please apply this important update.
Remove the old webhook code from config.lua
The spam bug in the reload function when using Ped has been fixed.
A progress bar was added when reloading.
The issue of displaying 'name by name' in ped requests has been fixed. It will now display 'first name last name'.
Players whose ped requests have been approved by the admin will now be able to access their ped request instantly in their menu.
All text in HTML and JS has been moved to Config.Locale
Improvements have been made to the style.css file for all screens.
Reloading now works on every ped model. Press R to reload; a new revolver-cylinder progress UI with a countdown is shown while reloading.
All visual bugs during reload (broken arms / stuck poses) are completely fixed. No reload animation is forced on the ped anymore.
Reload spam can no longer get you stuck, and reloading is blocked while aiming (same rule as the frameworks).

Weapon-type based reload sounds added (revolver, pistol, shotgun, sawed-off, repeater, rifle, sniper). Sounds are simple files in the new sounds/ folder and can be replaced by server owners - see SETUP.md.
New on-screen hints while playing as a ped: a red 'R - RELOAD' hint when your clip is empty, and an 'OUT OF AMMO' warning when your ammo is gone. Both can be turned off in config.

Full VORP and RSG-Core compatibility for reload and ammo. Ammo is always taken from and synced with your framework (VORP gunbelt / RSG ammo) - no free ammo, no ammo loss, and no other resource needs to be edited.
Restarting fx-pedmenu no longer freezes or bugs your character. If you are transformed into a ped, your ped and outfit are restored automatically after the restart (can be turned off in config).
New config options: ReloadTime, ReloadUI, ReloadSound, ReloadSoundVolume, ReloadPrompt, NoAmmoPrompt, RestorePedAfterRestart, WeaponReloadSounds.
Removed: the old spinning reload icon and the old reload behavior that played animations on the ped.
updateFiles: config.lua / new reload settings + new Config.Locale keys (reloading, reload_prompt, no_ammo)
